intro: A gentle herbal onion-based shampoo formulated to strengthen roots, reduce hair fall, and promote natural shine and softness.

li: Cleans hair from root to tip
Take a small amount in palm (as per hair length).
Massage gently into scalp for 2–3 mins.
Repeat if hair is very oily.
Follow with conditioner for best results.
Polyquaternium-10, Sodium cocoamphoacetate, CAPB (30%), Sodium lauroyl sarcosinate, PEG-150, D-Panthenol, Glycerin, Silk Protein, Preservatives (Cathon CG)
